prank_description: Hector swapped Kaio's scout compass with one slightly recalibrated by the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear.
summary: The recalibrated compass prank finally pays off as Hector grabs the baton from Kaio in the middle of a Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea.
narrative_prose: The Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea tore across the barren outcroppings, threatening to CONSUME any loose equipment left unsecured. Hector braced himself against the howling, magnetic winds, tasting the sharp, metallic static on his tongue while the bruising violet skies painted the chaotic waves below in stark relief. He fought to DEFEND his position, the freezing sleet stinging his exposed skin as the deafening roar of the tempest hammered his ears. Through the thick, localized sea mist meant to CONCEAL the worst of the jagged ironstone, he saw his opening. Lunging forward, Hector securely shoved the heavy physical baton into Kaio's waiting armored glove, completing the handoff before the next massive swell could shatter their foothold.
